name: valley-primal-v2
purpose: Certify Lemma M on the primal valley region V (same region and outcomes as spec_valley_v1.json), now with naive-then-mean-value-form enclosures (cert_valley_v2.py).
split_rule: bisect the dimension with the largest absolute width at the exact rational midpoint
arithmetic: python-flint 0.9.0 arb/acb, 128 bits; boxes enter as arb(lo).union(arb(hi)); MVF: F(B) in F(m) + sum_j dF_j(B) [-h_j, h_j] with dF_j(B) from first-order acb jets
fail_rule: any FAIL box, or stopping at eval_cap with boxes left, means no conclusion
